teaser.en: The 'black mlala', told apart from its relatives by the darkness of its bark.
teaser.sw: 'Mlala mweusi', unaotofautishwa na jamaa zake kwa weusi wa gome lake.

summary.en: Mlala mwiru is an ebony-family tree of the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania, named for its dark bark.
summary.sw: Mlala mwiru ni mti wa familia ya Ebenaceae (jamii ya *ebony*) wa misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, uliopewa jina kutokana na gome lake jeusi.

about.en: *Mlala mwiru* is a tree of the ebony family, *Diospyros*. Like its relatives it has simple, alternate, leathery leaves, small bell-shaped flowers and round fruits held in a persistent calyx. Pakia's informants identified it by its leaves, and its name comes from its comparatively dark bark.
about.sw: *Mlala mwiru* ni mti wa familia ya Ebenaceae, ile ya miti ya *ebony*, jenasi *Diospyros*. Kama jamaa zake, una majani sahili yanayopishana na magumu kama ngozi, maua madogo yenye umbo la kengele na matunda ya mviringo yanayoshikiliwa na kikombe cha ua (kaliksi) kisichodondoka. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake, na jina lake linatokana na gome lake lililo jeusi kiasi kuliko la jamaa zake.

where.en: It is native to south-eastern Kenya and Tanzania, in the dry coastal forests.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa asili wa kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na Tanzania, katika misitu mikavu ya pwani.

culture.en: Stem colour is one of the ways Digo speakers tell apart plants they see as related. Pakia sets *mlala mwiru* against *mlala mwereru* (*Monodora grandidieri*), which is the white form.
culture.sw: Rangi ya shina ni mojawapo ya njia ambazo Wadigo hutumia kutofautisha mimea wanayoiona kuwa ya jamaa moja. Pakia anaulinganisha *mlala mwiru* na *mlala mwereru* (*Monodora grandidieri*), ambao ndio aina nyeupe.

names.en: *Mlala mwiru* means 'black *mlala*', the black form of *mlala* (Pakia gives *mlala* as *Diospyros greenwayi*) because its bark is darker. At one point in his main text Pakia glosses the name as 'white mlala', which seems to be a slip, because his name notes and the colour words agree it is black (*mwiru*). The Mgombato dictionary gives *mlala* only as raffia, which is a different plant. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mlala mwiru* maana yake ni '*mlala* mweusi', aina nyeusi ya *mlala* (Pakia anatoa *mlala* kuwa *Diospyros greenwayi*) kwa sababu gome lake ni jeusi zaidi. Mahali pamoja katika maandishi yake makuu Pakia analieleza jina hili kuwa 'mlala mweupe', jambo linaloonekana kuwa kosa la kalamu, kwa sababu maelezo yake kuhusu majina na maneno ya rangi yanakubaliana kuwa ni mweusi (*mwiru*). Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mlala* kuwa mwale (raffia) tu, ambao ni mmea tofauti. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
